metadata.content:
The extraction cycle is ready for formal closure. The execution plan confirms LPR-008 through LPR-017 are complete and regression-certified, with no additional eligible primitive currently authorized.
Run the final closure milestone:
Bashcd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina && \
cat > /tmp/close-lumina-extraction-cycle.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

registry = Path(
    "docs/architecture/LUMINA_PRIMITIVE_EXTRACTION_REGISTRY.md"
)

plan = Path(
    "docs/architecture/LUMINA_CERTIFIED_EXTRACTION_EXECUTION_PLAN.md"
)

registry_source = registry.read_text()
plan_source = plan.read_text()

registry_original = registry_source
plan_original = plan_source

plan_replacements = {
    "- Execution status: LPR-017 complete":
    "- Execution status: Extraction cycle closed",

    "- Extraction status: LPR-008 through LPR-017 completed and regression-certified":
    "- Extraction status: LPR-008 through LPR-017 completed, regression-certified, and frozen",

    "- LPR-017 result: not ready; overlapping ownership and unconverged visual contracts\n":
    "- LPR-017 result: not ready; overlapping ownership and unconverged visual contracts\n"
    "- Closure result: no additional primitive is eligible without a new certification baseline\n",
}

registry_replacements = {
    "- Extraction status: Prohibited until future certification milestones":
    "- Extraction status: Current certified cycle closed; future extraction requires a new certification baseline",
}

closure_record = """
## Certified Extraction Cycle Closure

The Lumina certified extraction cycle covering LPR-008 through LPR-017 is closed.

Closure basis:

- all authorized extraction milestones are complete
- every migrated consumer passed the Regression Safety Gate
- all reconciliation milestones introduced zero production delta
- no remaining registry candidate satisfies the full extraction eligibility contract
- remaining candidates are Emerging, Experimental, workspace-specific, Domain-Owned, or explicitly Not Ready

Frozen certified results:

- LPR-008 — Standard Premium Panel
- LPR-009 — Prominent Premium Panel
- LPR-010 — Standard Premium Card
- LPR-011 — Executive Title and Metrics Composition
- LPR-012 — Balanced Split Panel Composition
- LPR-013 — Panel Header Composition
- LPR-014 — Status Badge and State Surface
- LPR-015 — Activity Feed Row Shell
- LPR-016 — Warning Surface Reconciliation
- LPR-017 — Section Header Block Reconciliation

Post-closure rules:

- no new LPR milestone may begin from the current registry alone
- no Emerging or Experimental candidate may be promoted by implementation pressure
- no workspace-specific composition may be extracted directly
- no existing certified primitive may be redesigned during closure
- no consumer migration may occur without a new visual certification baseline
- future extraction requires:
  - updated duplication evidence
  - updated cross-workspace convergence evidence
  - explicit semantic-boundary review
  - API stability review
  - screenshot baselines
  - rollback SHA
  - one-consumer-at-a-time migration plan
  - Regression Safety Gate approval

Deferred candidates:

- Compact premium card
- Asymmetric detail-panel composition
- Timeline card
- Inspector shell
- Command bar
- Filter bar
- Graph/topology container
- Empty state
- Loading state
- Detail panel
- Section header block

Final closure certification:

- Current extraction queue: Closed
- Additional eligible primitives: None
- Production component changes in closure milestone: None
- Consumer migrations in closure milestone: None
- Visual delta: None
- Behavioral delta: None
- Responsive delta: None
- Runtime Header remains excluded
"""

try:
    for old, new in plan_replacements.items():
        if plan_source.count(old) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"plan replacement mismatch: {old[:100]}"
            )
        plan_source = plan_source.replace(old, new, 1)

    for old, new in registry_replacements.items():
        if registry_source.count(old) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"registry replacement mismatch: {old[:100]}"
            )
        registry_source = registry_source.replace(old, new, 1)

    if "## Certified Extraction Cycle Closure" in plan_source:
        raise RuntimeError("closure record already exists")

    plan_source = (
        plan_source.rstrip()
        + "\n\n"
        + closure_record.strip()
        + "\n"
    )

    registry.write_text(registry_source)
    plan.write_text(plan_source)

except Exception:
    registry.write_text(registry_original)
    plan.write_text(plan_original)
    raise
PY

python3 /tmp/close-lumina-extraction-cycle.py && \
printf '%s\n' "===== CLOSURE DIFF =====" && \
git diff -- \
docs/architecture/LUMINA_CERTIFIED_EXTRACTION_EXECUTION_PLAN.md \

cat > /tmp/validate-lumina-extraction-closure.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

REGISTRY="docs/architecture/LUMINA_PRIMITIVE_EXTRACTION_REGISTRY.md"
PLAN="docs/architecture/LUMINA_CERTIFIED_EXTRACTION_EXECUTION_PLAN.md"
RUNTIME_HEADER="apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/runtime/parts/RuntimeHeader.tsx"

grep -Fq -- '- Execution status: Extraction cycle closed' "$PLAN"
grep -Fq -- '- Extraction status: LPR-008 through LPR-017 completed, regression-certified, and frozen' "$PLAN"
grep -Fq -- '- Closure result: no additional primitive is eligible without a new certification baseline' "$PLAN"
grep -Fq -- '## Certified Extraction Cycle Closure' "$PLAN"

grep -Fq -- 'Current extraction queue: Closed' "$PLAN"
grep -Fq -- 'Additional eligible primitives: None' "$PLAN"
grep -Fq -- 'Production component changes in closure milestone: None' "$PLAN"
grep -Fq -- 'Consumer migrations in closure milestone: None' "$PLAN"

grep -Fq -- '- Extraction status: Current certified cycle closed; future extraction requires a new certification baseline' "$REGISTRY"

unexpected="$(
  git diff --name-only |
    grep -v "^${RUNTIME_HEADER}$" |
    grep -v "^${REGISTRY}$" |
    grep -v "^${PLAN}$" || true
)"

test -z "$unexpected"

printf '%s\n' "extraction-cycle-closure-recorded: green"
printf '%s\n' "no-additional-eligible-primitives: green"
printf '%s\n' "production-delta: none"
printf '%s\n' "unrelated-files: green"

git diff --check
npm run build

printf '%s\n' "===== STATUS ====="
git status --short
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/validate-lumina-extraction-closure.sh && \
/tmp/validate-lumina-extraction-closure.sh
